name: Araucaria de la casa de la Misericordia
register_ref: Ajuntament de Barcelona, Arbres d'interes local (CC BY 4.0)
verify_notes: 27 m tall in the same courtyard as bcn_010, but the register gives no planting year and no independent source was found. It would also be a second entry on one small Raval courtyard.

name: Platan oriental de la Universitat
register_ref: Ajuntament de Barcelona, Arbres d'interes local (CC BY 4.0)
verify_notes: 1933, so 93 years, on a square rather than in a garden. A true Platanus orientalis rather than the usual London plane hybrid is genuinely uncommon in Spanish cities and this is worth a second look when Barcelona next grows. Would extend the Raval walk east to Placa de la Universitat.
